title: QuietManhunt
description: Competitive Manhunt plugin for Paper 1.21.1+ Features a ban phase, automatic plains village finder, cross-dimension compass tracking, and headstart countdown.
body:
## QuietManhunt

  A production-ready Manhunt plugin for Bukkit/Spigot/Paper servers.

  ## Features

  - GUI-based player selection for hunters and runners
  - Ban phase — players vote to ban item/mechanic categories before the game starts
  - Automatic village preparation with player teleport
  - Random runner selection
  - In-game timer
  - Multi-language support

  ## Commands

  | Command | Description | Permission |
  |---|---|---|
  | `/quiet_manhunt` | Opens the Manhunt GUI | `quiet.manhunt` |
  | `/quietprepare` | Finds a village and teleports players | `quiet.manhunt` |
  | `/quiet_random` | Selects a random runner | `quiet.manhunt` |
  | `/ban [number]` | Bans a category during ban phase | `quiet.ban` |
